rules.name: recon-snapshot-widen-preflight-dev-uat
rules.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, c.relkind::text AS kind, vw.lvl, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner, coalesce(c.relacl::text, '') AS acl, coalesce(array_to_string(c.reloptions, ','), '') AS options, coalesce(obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class'), '') AS view_comment, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns, (SELECT md5(string_agg(a.attname || ':' || a.atttypid::regtype::text, ',' ORDER BY a.attnum)) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS column_fingerprint FROM vw JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = vw.oid ORDER BY vw.lvl, c.relname

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, t.tgname AS trigger_name FROM vw JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = vw.oid JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid = c.oid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, r.rulename AS rule_name FROM vw JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = vw.oid JOIN pg_rewrite r ON r.ev_class = c.oid WHERE r.rulename <> '_RETURN'

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS relation_name, a.attname AS column_name, a.attacl::text AS column_acl FROM (SELECT oid FROM vw UNION SELECT c2.oid FROM pg_class c2 WHERE c2.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c2.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = x.oid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attacl IS NOT NULL AND NOT a.attisdropped

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, a.attname AS column_name, d.description FROM vw JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = vw.oid JOIN pg_description d ON d.objoid = c.oid AND d.classoid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND d.objsubid > 0 JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = d.objsubid

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, p.pubname FROM vw JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = vw.oid JOIN pg_publication_rel pr ON pr.prrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_publication p ON p.oid = pr.prpubid

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ), vw AS (SELECT oid, max(lvl) AS lvl FROM dep GROUP BY oid) SELECT pg_describe_object(dp.classid, dp.objid, dp.objsubid) AS dependent_object, dp.deptype::text AS deptype, coalesce(c.relname, t0.relname) AS depends_on FROM pg_depend dp LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = dp.refobjid AND dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass LEFT JOIN pg_type ty ON ty.oid = dp.refobjid AND dp.refclassid = 'pg_type'::regclass LEFT JOIN pg_class t0 ON t0.reltype = ty.oid WHERE dp.deptype <> 'i' AND dp.classid <> 'pg_rewrite'::regclass AND ((dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT oid FROM vw) AND dp.refobjsubid = 0) OR (dp.refclassid = 'pg_type'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN ( SELECT c3.reltype FROM pg_class c3 WHERE c3.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM vw) OR (c3.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c3.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot'))))) ORDER BY 1
